notes:
Desktop v5.0.59

  • New: Welcome screen data directory selection. First-run wizard now includes a dedicated step where users can browse and select their preferred data folder location for storing servers, JDKs, and configurations.
  • Fixed: Dashboard responsive layout. Online Players and Recent Activity cards now display side-by-side in a 50/50 split at screen widths 900px and above, collapsing to a single column on smaller screens.
  • Fixed: Marketplace pagination. Fixed offset tracking for lazy-loaded search results. Load-more now correctly resumes from the correct position instead of restarting from offset 0.
  • Fixed: Marketplace changelog URL fallback. Added cross-platform fallback for opening changelog URLs when Java Desktop API is unavailable, trying xdg-open (Linux) and cmd /c start (Windows) in sequence.

Mobile v5.0.40-mobilev2

  • New: Add-ons tab. Added dedicated Add-ons navigation tab with Chest icon for future Modrinth marketplace integration.
  • Fixed: ConsoleScreen drawable references. Added missing R class import for drawable resources in ConsoleScreen.
  • Improved: Navigation bar stability. Fixed layout size import in AppNavigation.

Desktop v5.0.58

  • Fixed: Window drag jitter (finally). Replaced Compose detectDragGestures with AWT Toolkit.addAWTEventListener for zero-latency native mouse interception. Title bar drag now handled entirely at the AWT level with a 4px drag threshold to avoid interfering with button clicks.
  • Fixed: Forge/NeoForge version loading lag. Wrapped blocking HTTP calls in withContext(Dispatchers.IO) so they no longer freeze the UI thread. Added in-memory builds cache per version so switching between versions is instant. NeoForge now shares the metadata XML between fetchVersions and fetchBuilds.
  • Improved: Import folder wizard auto-skip. When importing an existing server folder, the wizard now auto-skips Version, Build, RAM, Properties, and Storage steps directly to the EULA if a valid JAR file is found.
  • New: Runtime uninstall script generator. Added Settings > Uninstall section with "Save to Desktop" and "Choose Location" buttons. Generates a full uninstall batch script that closes PortalHost, removes Start Menu shortcuts, runs Windows Installer uninstall, cleans registry, and prompts for data removal (Y/N/K).

Desktop v5.0.57

  • New: In-app update download with progress. Update checker now downloads the MSI/EXE directly in-app with a progress dialog showing download speed, percentage, ETA, and cancel option. Auto-launches installer on completion.
  • New: Changelog in update dialog. The update dialog now displays release notes from the website changelog before downloading.
  • New: Server file refresh buttons. Added refresh buttons to Plugins, Mods, Datapacks, Worlds, and Server Files tabs for manual re-scan without app restart.
  • New: Floating Action Button (FAB) for creating servers. Replaced the rectangular "Create Server" grid card with a Material3 FAB anchored bottom-right on the Servers screen.
  • New: Centered empty state. When no servers exist, the Servers tab now shows a centered DNS icon, title, subtitle, and a prominent FAB to create the first server.
  • Improved: Welcome screen. Expanded to 4 steps with step-by-step progress indicators, data folder setup, optional JDK install with "Skip for now" fallback, and configuration step. Added "Skip for now" link at bottom.
  • Improved: Window dragging. Replaced jittery SwingUtilities.invokeLater with direct java.awt.EventQueue.invokeLater setLocation() and added move cursor feedback during drag.
  • Improved: Enhanced uninstaller. Updated Uninstall.bat with registry preference cleanup, data removal prompt (Keep/Remove/Keep Servers options), Start Menu shortcut removal, and self-deletion.
  • Fixed: Dashboard empty state. Removed the "Create Server" button from Dashboard empty state; now directs users to the Servers tab for server creation.
  • Fixed: Update checker cache. Added 1-hour cache to avoid rate limiting on repeated checks.
  • Fixed: Deprecated API cleanup. Replaced LocalClipboardManager with LocalClipboard, updated menuAnchor() calls to use ExposedDropdownMenuAnchorType.

Desktop v5.0.56

  • Fixed: Auto-scroll button no longer covers console output. The scroll-to-bottom FAB in the server console was positioned at the top-right corner of the console area, covering log output. Changed alignment to Alignment.BottomEnd so it sits at the bottom-right where it doesn't obstruct the view.
  • Fixed: Dashboard console command input detects Enter key. The mini command input in the dashboard console card now properly detects the Enter key press to send commands, matching the full console screen behavior.
  • Fixed: Import server folder now uses proper directory picker. Replaced AWT FileDialog with JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY mode for the server folder import dialog, giving a proper folder selection interface on Windows.
  • Fixed: Imported server folders now copy all files. registerImportedServer() now copies the entire source server directory (plugins/, mods/, world/, server.properties, etc.) to the new server location instead of just the JAR file. Previously, only the JAR was copied, leaving plugins and other files behind in the original folder.
  • Changed: Server status badge now shows “Online” instead of “Running”. The status label on server cards and detail screen now displays “Online” for running servers, making it clearer that the server is joinable.

Desktop v5.0.55

  • Fixed: Quit button no longer shows system tray notification. Clicking "Quit" in the close dialog now properly stops all running servers, removes the tray icon, and exits cleanly without ever displaying a "minimized to tray" notification.
  • Fixed: Ctrl+Q now exits cleanly. The Ctrl+Q keyboard shortcut no longer performs a hard kill with System.exit(0). It now triggers the same proper quit flow as the dialog button, stopping all running servers and removing the tray icon before exiting.
  • Fixed: Window dragging jitter eliminated. The custom title bar's drag gesture detector was restarting mid-drag because it used the window reference as a pointerInput key, which is unstable across recompositions. Changed the key to Unit (always stable), eliminating the jitter completely.
  • Fixed: Server import no longer creates duplicate folders. When importing a server JAR, the app was creating both a user-named folder and a UUID-named folder. This was caused by registerImportedServer() not having the server config in the in-memory map when resolving the directory, falling back to UUID-based resolution. The fix adds the config to _servers before calling getServerDir(), so it correctly resolves to the sanitized name folder.
  • Fixed: Orphaned UUID folders cleaned up. loadServersFromDatabase() now deletes empty UUID-named folders after migrating flat JAR files to the correct subfolder structure.
  • Fixed: Server import no longer uses flat intermediate location. The server creation wizard no longer copies imported JAR files to a flat servers/{uuid}.jar location before registering. It now passes the original file directly to registerImportedServer(), eliminating an unnecessary copy operation and reducing import time.
  • New: Import Existing Server Folder. Added a new option in the server creation wizard to import an existing Minecraft server directory. The wizard scans server.properties to auto-populate server name, port, MOTD, gamemode, and difficulty, and also discovers JAR files in the folder.

Desktop v5.0.54

  • Fixed resource loading error: renamed Ender_Dragon_Portal.png to lowercase ender_dragon_portal.png for case-sensitive filesystem compatibility (Linux/macOS/JAR packaging)
  • All file pickers now have proper extension filters across all dialogs
  • Update checker uses website latest.json as primary source with GitHub fallbacks

Desktop v5.0.53

  • Added "Browse" button to Import World from ZIP dialog — native file picker with .zip filter for easier world imports
  • Extended file picker filters across all dialogs: server icons (png, jpg, jpeg), server JARs (jar), world imports (zip), plugins/mods (jar, multi-select), datapacks (zip, multi-select), server file uploads (jar, zip, json, yml, yaml, properties, txt, conf, config, toml, dat, db, log, multi-select)
  • Updated UpdateChecker to use portalhost.pages.dev/latest.json as primary update source (public, no auth, no rate limits) with GitHub API and HTML scraping as fallbacks
  • Rebuilt MSI (~121 MB) and EXE (~122 MB) installers with updated update checker

Desktop v5.0.52

  • Fixed close dialog "Quit" button — now properly stops all running servers and exits the application cleanly (previously just hid the window without cleanup)
  • Removed GitHub token initialization from main() — token now passed explicitly to UpdateChecker.checkForUpdate() only when user provides it in Settings
  • Updated version to 5.0.52 across all build files
  • Removed unused Base64 import from UpdateChecker
  • Fixed window visibility state handling on close dialog

Desktop v5.0.51

  • Fixed window dragging jitter in TitleBar — replaced custom drag logic with pixel-perfect detectDragGestures implementation
  • Fixed FilePicker deadlock — completely rewrote FilePicker.kt as proper suspend function using withContext(Dispatchers.IO), removing blocking SwingUtilities.invokeLater + synchronized wait pattern
  • Server folders now use sanitized server name instead of UUID (with UUID fallback for backward compatibility)
  • Enabled native Windows file dialog via awt.fileDialog.useNativeLF=true
  • All 6 FilePicker call sites updated to use coroutine scope launch

Desktop v5.0.50 — Major UI Overhaul

  • Complete Material3 design system migration with dark theme matching Minecraft aesthetic
  • New 6-step server creation wizard: Version → Type → Build → Java → Memory → Finish
  • Real-time console with color-coded log levels, command history (up/down arrows), search/filter, and auto-scroll toggle
  • Player management: ban/unban players & IPs, kick, whitelist add/remove, op/de-op, online player list with UUIDs
  • World management: import/export as ZIP, create/delete/switch worlds, world folder size display
  • Plugin/mod/datapack management: drag-and-drop JAR/ZIP upload, multi-select, delete, version display
  • System tray integration: minimize to tray, quick start/stop/restart, show/hide window, server status tooltip
  • Automatic JDK detection and installation — downloads Adoptium Temurin JDK 8/11/17/21 based on server version requirements
  • Multi-version support: Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia, Vanilla with build selection per version
  • Server properties editor with live preview for MOTD color codes (§0-§f, §l, §o, §n, §m, §k, §r)
  • RCON configuration panel with enable/disable, port, password fields
  • Auto-restart and auto-backup toggles with configurable intervals

Mobile v5.0.40

  • Initial mobile release with full server management capabilities
  • Background server hosting via foreground service with persistent notification
  • Complete server lifecycle: create, configure, start, stop, restart, delete servers
  • 6-step server creation wizard with Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia, Vanilla support
  • Player management: view online players with ping, whitelist, operators, banned players/IPs
  • Real-time console with ANSI color support, log level filtering, search, command history
  • Performance charts: live CPU%, RAM usage, TPS history graphs
  • playit.gg tunnel integration for public server access
  • RCON remote console support with authentication
  • File management: worlds, plugins, mods, datapacks, backups — upload, download, delete, rename
  • Automatic JDK installation with device-appropriate version selection
  • Dark/Light theme support with system sync

Android v5.0.30 — Initial Android Release

  • Full Minecraft Java Edition server manager for Android 7.0+ (API 24)
  • Background server hosting via foreground service with persistent notification showing CPU/RAM/TPS
  • Complete server lifecycle: create, configure, start, stop, restart, delete servers
  • 6-step server creation wizard with same server type support as desktop
  • Player management: view online players with ping, whitelist, operators, banned players/IPs with add/remove
  • Real-time console with ANSI color support, log level filtering, search, command history, copy/share
  • Performance charts: live CPU%, RAM usage, TPS history graphs with configurable time ranges
  • playit.gg tunnel integration — create public TCP tunnels for server access without port forwarding
  • RCON remote console support with authentication, command sending, response display
  • File management: worlds, plugins, mods, datapacks, backups — upload, download, delete, rename
  • Automatic JDK installation (Adoptium Temurin) with device-appropriate version selection
  • Device-aware RAM/GC configuration — automatically tunes -Xms/-Xmx and GC flags based on available memory
  • Battery optimization exemption request to keep servers running in background
  • Dark/Light theme support with system sync and manual override
  • APK size: ~15 MB (native/PortalHost.apk), package: com.portalhost.app, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36

Desktop v5.0.25

  • Custom WiX installer template (template.wxs) with branded UI, license agreement, and custom actions
  • Creates "Uninstall PortalHost.lnk" shortcut in Start Menu and self-locating Uninstall.bat in install folder
  • Uninstall.bat uses %~dp0 for self-location — works regardless of working directory
  • Update checker with GitHub API (authenticated) and HTML fallback scraping for private repo access
  • Release tag regex handles suffixes like -desktop, -mobile for multi-platform releases
  • GitHub token support stored in DataStore preferences — user enters PAT in Settings → Updates
  • Version parsing compares major.minor.patch numerically, ignores pre-release suffixes
  • Toast notifications for update available, download progress, install ready

Desktop v5.0.20 — Compose Multiplatform Migration

  • Full migration from Swing/JavaFX to Compose Multiplatform (Kotlin 1.9+, Compose 1.5+)
  • Kotlin Multiplatform project structure: commonMain (shared logic), desktopMain (JVM UI)
  • ServerManager with sanitized folder names (replaces invalid chars: \ / : * ? " < > | with _)
  • Preferences via Multiplatform Settings (DataStore on JVM) — JDK paths, GitHub token, theme, auto-update
  • Dashboard with server cards showing status badge, version, type, memory, port, quick actions
  • ProcessManager with ManagedProcess wrapper — stdout/stderr capture, PID tracking, graceful shutdown
  • ServerDownloader with PaperMC, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia API integrations
  • JdkManager auto-detects installed JDKs, downloads missing versions from Adoptium API
  • SQLite database via SQLDelight for server configs, console logs, backup metadata, player data
  • Koin dependency injection for all services (ServerManager, ProcessManager, JdkManager, etc.)
